provenance.execution: Sequential Node worker_threads with canonical supervisor, observed current box and remaining counts only.

rule.gate: All selection runs finished, zero violations and deadline misses. ALPS selection mean fill must be within 5 percentage points of the best conventional selection mean fill.
rule.rule: Highest weighted mean on selection seeds only. Baseline = best conventional score. ALPS = best of floor-dense/cluster-floor/cluster-layer after fill gate. Lowest = lowest score among all eligible tested policies, including the deliberately dispersed control.
rule.caution: User-priority decision score, not an industry standard or universal optimality certificate. Independent evaluation never changes selected IDs or display seed.

definitions.sameSkuContact: Sum of shared face area between identical SKUs / all box-to-box shared face area. Each pair counted once; pallet boundary excluded. Null with no contacts.
definitions.sameSkuVertical: Same-SKU touching horizontal face area / all touching horizontal face area. Non-touching XY projections are excluded; null when no vertical contact.
definitions.sameDepartmentContact: Shared face area within S1/S2, S3/S4, or S5/S6 / all shared face area. Distinct from exact SKU similarity.
definitions.largestComponentShare: Sum of largest face-connected component sizes per SKU / placed count. Reported with count and contact purity to avoid singleton inflation.

limits: Synthetic one-pallet six-SKU workload; arrival seeds vary but dimensions, inventory and pallet are fixed.
No claim of globally most/least efficient algorithm. Negative control intentionally minimizes SKU clustering.
10-second cycle and redistribution seconds are model assumptions, not measured real-cell times.
Exploratory unadjusted 95% paired Student t intervals over arrival seeds; score weights are design priorities.
Mixed loading does not prove clustering improves redistribution: both are separately computed.
